title: Jaya
overview: Balaji, Kannan, Michael, and Salim are four close friends, each struggling with personal setbacks and aspirations. Their lives change when they meet Jaya, a spirited young woman who motivates them to pursue their goals with determination and self-belief. But behind Jaya’s resilience lies a painful past—she lost her best friend Priya during college, a tragedy linked to the sinister deeds of three influential men. Fueled by a desire for justice, Jaya embarks on a bold mission to expose and confront the person truly responsible.
